instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a small public lobby with a flat entrance canopy and four windows. The architect has upgraded the glazing and wants the canopy recognised as a reusable entrance roof assembly while preserving the lobby massing and main opening layout. Keep the lobby shell, slab, canopy roof, entrance door, windows, and openings. Assign the canopy to the entrance canopy type, record the upgraded glazing status on each window, and stamp the lobby elements and canopy type with revision code BONSAI-CLI-15.
